_comment: Predictions about the settings record, derived from the vendor binary
BEFORE the capture that tests them. Kept in a separate file from
fieldmap.py on purpose: CLAUDE.md §7.1 deleted a previous tool because it
carried its conclusions inside it, so anyone reading the tool inherited
them. fieldmap.py must observe without expecting; this file expects; and
score.py is the only place the two meet.
Every entry needs a `cite` and a `refuted_if`. An entry with no way to

predictions.refuted_if: a polling line moves no byte at record 0x05, or moves it to a value outside {1,2,4,8,16,32,64}, or rate*value != 8000

predictions.claim: record 0x0e is the CPI stage count, 1..4
predictions.refuted_if: a CPI-levels line moves no byte at record 0x0e, or moves it outside 1..4
